context.canonical_title: MySQL 备份与基于 binlog 的恢复流程

required_checks: Resolve the source_type_overridden risk from authoritative source rows before deciding whether mechanism is the correct final answer type.
Verify MySQL 8.4 mysqldump --single-transaction and --source-data consistency/locking semantics, including nontransactional-table and concurrent-DDL boundaries.
Verify PITR prerequisites, binary-log continuity, mysqlbinlog time-vs-position usage and exact stop-boundary semantics from current MySQL primary documentation.
Verify physical-vs-logical and online-backup claims and reject any implication that copying a live InnoDB data directory is automatically a consistent backup.
Check restore verification, RPO/RTO evidence boundaries, retention/gap detection, isolation-instance workflow, rollback/cutover and sensitive backup handling.
Verify every source variant is directly answered and hypothetical recovery examples cannot be read as fabricated production experience.
review_contract.promotion_boundary: Do not promote or fabricate human approval. Pilot human review remains a separate mandatory gate when required by config.

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: MySQL 8.4 Establishing a Backup Policy
claims_to_check: --source-data with --single-transaction acquires a global read lock initially, reads binary-log coordinates, then releases it while InnoDB dump continues
nontransactional tables must not change during the backup for consistency

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: MySQL 8.4 Backup and Recovery Types
claims_to_check: physical and logical backups have distinct portability/performance properties
online physical backups require appropriate locking or a backup tool that supplies consistency
backup encryption protects backed-up data against unauthorized access and belongs in backup policy

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: MySQL 8.4 Point-in-Time Recovery
claims_to_check: PITR starts from a full backup and applies subsequent binary-log changes incrementally

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: MySQL 8.4 Point-in-Time Recovery Using Binary Log
claims_to_check: binary logging is required for PITR and is enabled by default in MySQL 8.4
mysqlbinlog supports selecting events by time and position

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: MySQL 8.4 LOCK INSTANCE FOR BACKUP
claims_to_check: instance backup lock permits DML while preventing operations that could make an online snapshot inconsistent
